```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
draw_label_theme <- function(label, theme = NULL, element = "text", ...) {
  if (is.null(theme)) {
    theme <- ggplot2::theme_get()
  }
  if (!element %in% names(theme)) {
    stop("Element must be a valid ggplot theme element name")
  }

  elements <- ggplot2::calc_element(element, theme)

  cowplot::draw_label(label, 
                      fontfamily = elements$family,
                      fontface = elements$face,
                      colour = elements$color,
                      size = elements$size,
                      ...
  )
}
```

# B. uMAP plot of 59K cells, split by urbc/irbc

```{r umap plots of in vitro data, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Import the reference mapped, subsampled 50K in vitro object

refmapped.invitro <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/ in vitro samples integrated and reference mapped 59k non downsampled object 27May 2026.rds")

all.split <- SplitObject(refmapped.invitro, split.by ="phenotype")
all_apara <- all.split$aparasitemic
apara_split <- SplitObject(all_apara, split.by = "stim")

all_para <- all.split$parasitemic
para_split <- SplitObject(all_para, split.by = "stim")
```

```{r prepare pf stim umaps, fig.align='center', fig.height=4, fig.width=7.5}
#plot umap of all cells, colored by celltype
plot_umap_allcells <- DimPlot(refmapped.invitro,
                             reduction = "ref.umap",
                             group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", 
                             label = TRUE, 
                             label.size = 4, 
                             repel = TRUE,
                             pt.size = 0.03, 
                             raster = F, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "all cells") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "all stimulation")

plot_umap_apara_urbc <- DimPlot(apara_split$urbc,
                               reduction = "ref.umap",
                               group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", 
                               label = TRUE, 
                               label.size = 4, 
                               repel = TRUE,
                               pt.size = 0.03, 
                               raster = F, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "uRBC")

plot_umap_apara_irbc <- DimPlot(apara_split$irbc,
                               reduction = "ref.umap",
                               group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", 
                               label = TRUE, 
                               label.size = 4, 
                               repel = TRUE,
                               pt.size = 0.03, 
                               raster = F, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "PfRBC")

plot_umap_para_urbc <- DimPlot(para_split$urbc,
                               reduction = "ref.umap",
                               group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", 
                               label = TRUE, 
                               label.size = 4, 
                               repel = TRUE,
                               pt.size = 0.03, 
                               raster = F, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "uRBC")

plot_umap_para_irbc <- DimPlot(para_split$irbc,
                               reduction = "ref.umap",
                               group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2", 
                               label = TRUE, 
                               label.size = 4, 
                               repel = TRUE,
                               pt.size = 0.03, 
                               raster = F, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "PfRBC")

plot_umap_all <- bind_rows(plot_umap_apara_urbc, plot_umap_apara_irbc, plot_umap_para_urbc, plot_umap_para_irbc) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("uRBC", "PfRBC"))) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("parasitemic", "aparasitemic")))

strip <- strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c("orchid1", "orchid3", alpha = 0.6)),
                             background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c("#e41a1c", "#58a4cb", alpha = 0.6)))

cells_to_label <- c("CD14 Mono", "CD14 Mono", "B intermediate", "B memory", "B naive", "pDC", "cDC2")
new_colors = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(10,"Spectral"))(length(unique(plot_umap_all$predicted.celltype.l2)))
cells_to_label <- c("CD14 Mono", "CD16 Mono")
find_center <- function(my_vector) my_vector[ceiling(length(my_vector)/2)]

all_umap_plot <- plot_umap_all %>%
  group_by(class, treatment, predicted.celltype.l2) %>%
  mutate(midval_umap1_by_celltype = find_center(UMAP_1)) %>%
  mutate(midval_umap2_by_celltype = find_center(UMAP_2)) %>%
  mutate(minval_umap1_by_celltype = min(UMAP_1)) %>%
  mutate(minval_umap2_by_celltype = min(UMAP_2)) %>%
  mutate(maxval_umap1_by_celltype = max(UMAP_1)) %>%
  mutate(maxval_umap2_by_celltype = max(UMAP_2)) %>%
  mutate(cell_label = as.character(predicted.celltype.l2)) %>%
  mutate(label_center = ifelse(predicted.celltype.l2 %in% cells_to_label & UMAP_1 == midval_umap1_by_celltype, cell_label, "")) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(predicted.celltype.l2 %in% c("CD14 Mono", "CD16 Mono", "NK", "NK_CD56bright") & UMAP_2 == midval_umap2_by_celltype, cell_label, "")) %>%
  #mutate(label = ifelse(predicted.celltype.l2 %in% c("CD16 Mono" & UMAP_2 == minval_umap2_by_celltype, cell_label, label)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = predicted.celltype.l2)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = new_colors) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), color = "black", size = 2.75) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "left",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
        legend.key.size = unit(1, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.2,0.2,0.2,0.2), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(treatment), strip = strip) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cell type",
                               override.aes = list(size=2.5)))
```

```{r arrange GSEA of irbc vs urbc , include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
apara_mast <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/MAST_deglists_invitro/aparasitemic iRBC v uRBC/mast_deglists_filtmatrices_irbc_v_urbc_aparasitemic_notdownsampled_54.5k_apara_invitro.rds") %>%
  bind_rows(., .id = "celltype") %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic")

para_mast <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/MAST_deglists_invitro/parasitemic iRBC v uRBC/mast_deglists_filtmatrices_irbc_v_urbc_parasitemic_notdownsampled_54.5k_apara_invitro.rds") %>%
  bind_rows(., .id = "celltype") %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic")

mast_dge_gsea <- rbind(apara_mast, para_mast)

hall_invitro_all_celltypes <- mast_dge_gsea %>%
                      dplyr::filter(., grepl("MSigDB_Hallmark_v7.4", module_type))


basetextsize <- 9
myfont <- "sans"
bubble_max_size <- 8

# Add Scale_y_limits to include aparasitemic and show no differential enrichment there
invitro_irbc_plot <- hall_invitro_all_celltypes %>%
  mutate(comparison = factor(class, levels=c("aparasitemic", "parasitemic"), labels = c("Δ aparasitemic","Δ parasitemic"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(pathway = gsub("INTERFERON", "IFN", pathway)) %>%
  mutate(pathway = gsub("ALPHA", "α", pathway)) %>%
  mutate(pathway = gsub("BETA", "β", pathway)) %>%
  mutate(pathway = gsub("GAMMA", "γ", pathway)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = comparison, y= pathway, fill = NES)) +
  geom_point(aes(size=neglogpadj), shape=21, stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.6, show.legend=TRUE) +
  scale_size_area(name = expression(-log[10]~adj.~p~value), max_size = bubble_max_size) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "mediumblue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red2",
                       name = "up uRBC    up PfRBC",
                       limits = c(-3,3.2),
                       breaks = c(-3,-1.5, 0, 1.5, 3.2)) +
  hrbrthemes::theme_ipsum_es(base_family = myfont, base_size = basetextsize) +
  #ylab("pathway") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(),
        #axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "right",
        legend.box="horizontal",
        legend.margin=margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.2,0.2,0.2,0.2), "null"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = 'off') +
  facet_grid2(cols = NULL, rows = vars(celltype), scales="free_y", independent = "none", space="free", shrink=TRUE)
```

# Plot pseudotime trajectories for NK cells and monocytes in vitro

```{r pseudotime trajectory of monocytes, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=3.85, fig.height=3.5}
# monocytes


Idents(mono_in) <- mono_in$phenotype_stim
apucells <- WhichCells(mono_in, idents = "aparasitemic_urbc")
apicells <- WhichCells(mono_in, idents = "aparasitemic_irbc")
pucells <- WhichCells(mono_in, idents = "parasitemic_urbc")
picells <- WhichCells(mono_in, idents = "parasitemic_irbc")

apu_traj_dat <- FeaturePlot(mono_in, "log_pseudo_traj", pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "monocle.umap", keep.scale = NULL, cells = apucells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "uRBC")

api_traj_dat <- FeaturePlot(mono_in, "log_pseudo_traj", pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "monocle.umap", keep.scale = NULL, cells = apicells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "aparasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "PfRBC")

pu_traj_dat <- FeaturePlot(mono_in, "log_pseudo_traj", pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "monocle.umap", keep.scale = NULL, cells = pucells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "uRBC")

pi_traj_dat <- FeaturePlot(mono_in, "log_pseudo_traj", pt.size = 3.5, reduction = "monocle.umap", keep.scale = NULL, cells = picells, alpha = 0.45, combine = FALSE)[[1]]$data %>%
  mutate(class = "parasitemic") %>%
  mutate(treatment = "PfRBC")

all_traj_dat_mono <- bind_rows(apu_traj_dat,
                          api_traj_dat,
                          pu_traj_dat,
                          pi_traj_dat) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("uRBC", "PfRBC"))) %>%
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = c("parasitemic", "aparasitemic")))

library(ggh4x)
strip <- strip_themed(background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = c("orchid1", "orchid3", alpha = 0.6)),
                      background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = c("#e41a1c", "#58a4cb", alpha = 0.6)))

all_traj_plot_mono <- all_traj_dat_mono %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = monocleumap_1, y = monocleumap_2, fill = log_pseudo_traj)) +
  geom_point(pch=21, size = 2, color = "gray50", stroke = 0.25) +
  xlab("UMAP 1") +
  ylab("UMAP 2") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "pseudotime", n.breaks= 10,
                       guide = guide_colorbar(frame.colour = "gray50", ticks.colour = "gray50")) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("CD14 Mono") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  facet_grid2(rows = vars(class), cols = vars(treatment), strip = strip)

all_traj_plot_mono
```

# E heatmaps for pseudotime

```{r fig.align='center',fig.width=5.5, fig.height=3.5}
# Monocytes

cds_pr_test_monocytes_in_filt<-cds_pr_test_mon %>%
  arrange(q_value, desc(abs(morans_I))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 35)

mat <- mono_in[["RNA"]]$data %>% as.data.frame()
mat <- mat[rownames(cds_pr_test_monocytes_in_filt),] %>% as.matrix()
mat <- t(scale(t(mat),  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))
metadata_reduced <- mono_in@meta.data[colnames(mat),] #need to reduce metadata
all(rownames(metadata_reduced) == colnames(mat))

cluster_anno <- data.frame(early.mid.late = factor(gtools::quantcut(metadata_reduced$log_pseudo_traj, q = 3), labels = c("early", "mid", "late")),
                           pseudotime = metadata_reduced$log_pseudo_traj,
                           treatment = factor(ifelse(metadata_reduced$stim == "irbc", "PfRBC", "uRBC"), levels = c("uRBC", "PfRBC")),
                           class = factor(metadata_reduced$phenotype, levels = c("parasitemic", "aparasitemic")))
rownames(cluster_anno) <- colnames(mat)

#how to customize colors for column annotations, all names have to match what was defined in the cluster_annot df
clab <- list("early.mid.late" = c("early" = "gray85", "mid" = "gray60", "late" = "gray25"),
             "pseudotime" = circlize::colorRamp2(quantile(mono_in@meta.data$log_pseudo_traj, seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)), viridis::viridis(101)), #use viridis for consistency with dotplot
             "class" = c("aparasitemic" = "#58a4cb", "parasitemic"= "#e41a1c"),
             "treatment" = c("uRBC" = "orchid1", "PfRBC"= "orchid3"))
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = cluster_anno, col = clab, na_col = "lavender",
                        simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
                        annotation_legend_param = list(annotation_name_side = "left", nrow = 1),
                        annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 10),
                        show_legend = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE))

# id_ordered_by_pseudotime <- metadata_reduced %>%
#   arrange(log_pseudo_traj) %>%
#   rownames_to_column(var = "newid") %>%
#   pull(newid)
# mat <- mat[, id_ordered_by_pseudotime]
col_fun = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-max(abs(mat)), 0, max(abs(mat))), c("blue", "white", "red"))

#construct custom legends
lgd_list <- list(lgd1 = Legend(labels = c("aparasitemic", "parasitemic"), legend_gp = gpar(fill = c( "#58a4cb", "#e41a1c")), title = "class", type = "grid"),
                 lgd2 = Legend(labels = c("uRBC", "PfRBC"), legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("orchid1", "orchid3")), title = "treatment", type = "grid"))

my_hm_mono <- Heatmap(mat,
                 top_annotation = ha,
                 show_column_names = FALSE,
                 clustering_method_columns = NULL,
                 column_order = order(as.numeric(metadata_reduced$log_pseudo_traj)), #add this to order by pseudotime
                 cluster_columns = FALSE,
                 row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
                 row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize =7),
                 column_title = "cells",
                 column_title_side = "bottom",
                 row_title = "top differentially expressed genes",
                 row_title_side = "right",
                 show_heatmap_legend = FALSE)
                 #heatmap_legend_param = list(
                  # title = "z-score",
                   #legend_direction = "horizontal", 
                   #title_position = "lefttop",
                   #legend_width = unit(3, "cm")))

my_hm_mono
```

# Figure 6f: Pf transcript abundance

```{r pf transcript abundance,fig.align='center', fig.height=4, fig.width=5.35}

# Import invitro Pf object with only housekeeping/18srRNA/structural genes and human metadata

invitro.pf_subset <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/invitro_hs_seuratobj_with normalized 18s rRNA metagene and Hs metadata.rds")

# subset monocytes

invitro.mono <- subset(invitro.pf_subset, subset= predicted.celltype.l2== "CD14 Mono")

# re-parametrize to get a phenotype stim
invitro.mono$outcome_stim <- paste0(invitro.mono$phenotype, "_", invitro.mono$stim)


Idents(invitro.mono) <- "outcome_stim"

invitro_mono_plot <- VlnPlot(invitro.mono, features = c( "Pf3D7-18S-Metagene"), pt.size = 0.01, alpha = 0.1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


invitro_mono_plot

# let's make a proper boxplot for this
gg_mono_pf_plot_norm <- data.frame("barcode" = rownames(invitro_mono_plot@data),
                              "outcome" = invitro_mono_plot@data$ident, 
                              "Pf_transcripts" = invitro_mono_plot@data$`Pf3D7-18S-Metagene`) %>%
  mutate(outcome = tolower(outcome)) 

mycomparisons <- list(c("aparasitemic\nuRBC", "aparasitemic\nPfRBC"), c("parasitemic\nuRBC", "parasitemic\nPfRBC"), c("aparasitemic\nPfRBC", "parasitemic\nPfRBC"))

symnum.args <- list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))

gg_Pfplot_invitro_mono_tot_norm <- gg_mono_pf_plot_norm %>%
  mutate(outcome = case_when(
    outcome == "aparasitemic_urbc" ~ "aparasitemic\nuRBC",
    outcome == "aparasitemic_irbc" ~ "aparasitemic\nPfRBC", 
    outcome == "parasitemic_urbc" ~ "parasitemic\nuRBC",
    outcome == "parasitemic_irbc" ~ "parasitemic\nPfRBC",
     TRUE ~ "Other"))%>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = factor(outcome, levels = c("aparasitemic\nuRBC", "aparasitemic\nPfRBC", "parasitemic\nuRBC", "parasitemic\nPfRBC")), y = Pf_transcripts, colour = outcome)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, size=0.04, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, color = "gray20", alpha = 0, stroke=0.001) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("class: coculture") +
  ylab("log(Total number of Pf transcripts)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10.5),
        #plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black", face = "italic"),#,
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  ylab("Normalized Pf 3D7 18s rRNA expression") +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("aparasitemic\nuRBC" = "#a1cdf1",
                               "aparasitemic\nPfRBC" = "#58a4cb", 
                               "parasitemic\nuRBC" = "#f2b2b3",
                               "parasitemic\nPfRBC" = "#e41a1c")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = mycomparisons, 
                     method = "wilcox", show.legend = FALSE, size = 3)
```

# Figure 6g: proportion of phagocytosing monocytes in ap vs p

```{r num phagocytes, fig.height=4, fig.width=4, fig.align='center'}

invitro.hs_subset <- readRDS( "~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-IndianaUniversity/Desktop/R21 Sterile Immunity data and scripts/All scRNA-seq GEX consolidated (CITE-exvivo and multiome)/In vitro/invitro_hs_seuratobj_with normalized 18s rRNA metagene and Hs metadata.rds")

# subset monocytes
invitro.mono <- subset(invitro.hs_subset, subset= predicted.celltype.l2 == "CD14 Mono")

pf_phagocytosing_monos_plot <- invitro.mono@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::rename(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene = `Pf3D7-18S-Metagene`) %>%
  mutate(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene = ifelse(is.na(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene), 0, Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene)) %>%
  mutate(Pf_transctipt_presence = ifelse(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene > 0, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(barcode, delim = "_", names_sep = "") %>%
  subset(barcode2 == "irbc") %>%
  mutate(phagocytosing_monocytes = ifelse(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene > 5, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(barcode1 %in% c("kali0604", "kali0628", "kali0651"), "parasitemic", "aparasitemic")) %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(class== "aparasitemic", "aparasitemic\nPfRBC", "parasitemic\nPfRBC")) %>%
  group_by(class, phagocytosing_monocytes)%>%
  summarise(num= n()) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x= class, y= num, fill= phagocytosing_monocytes)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(y = "Percentage", x = "Group") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5E4FA2", "#F46D43"))  +
  xlab("class") +
  ylab("% of total monocytes") +
  labs(fill = "phagocytosing\nmonocytes") +
  theme_bw()
```

# Figure 6h: number of trasncripts within each class

```{r tx per cell, fig.align='center', fig.width=4, fig.height=4}

mycomparisons <- list(c("aparasitemic\nPfRBC", "parasitemic\nPfRBC"))

pf_phagocytosing_monos__tx_levels_plot <- invitro.mono@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::rename(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene = `Pf3D7-18S-Metagene`) %>%
  mutate(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene = ifelse(is.na(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene), 0, Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene)) %>%
  mutate(Pf_transctipt_presence = ifelse(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene > 0, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(., "barcode") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(barcode, delim = "_", names_sep = "") %>%
  subset(barcode2 == "irbc") %>%
  mutate(phagocytosing_monocytes = ifelse(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene > 5, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(barcode1 %in% c("kali0604", "kali0628", "kali0651"), "parasitemic", "aparasitemic")) %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(class== "aparasitemic", "aparasitemic\nPfRBC", "parasitemic\nPfRBC")) %>%
  subset(phagocytosing_monocytes== "Yes") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x= class, y= log(Pf3D7_18srRNA_metagene), fill= class, color= class)) + 
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(width = 0.2, size=1.5, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, color = "gray20", alpha = 0.2, stroke=0.001) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("class") +
  ylab("Normalized Pf 3D7 18s rRNA expression") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.margin = margin(),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.75, "lines"),
        legend.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
        #plot.margin=unit(c(0.1,0.1,0.1,0.1), "null"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", face = "italic"),#,
        strip.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("aparasitemic\nPfRBC" = "#58a4cb",
                               "parasitemic\nPfRBC" = "#e41a1c")) +
  scale_color_manual(values= c("aparasitemic\nPfRBC" = "#58a4cb",
                               "parasitemic\nPfRBC" = "#e41a1c")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = mycomparisons, 
                     method = "wilcox", show.legend = FALSE, size = 3)
```
